Current wording of [3.2.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md#v32-session-binding):

> Verify that session tokens are generated using approved cryptographic algorithms.

This doesn't really make sense in the context nor does it really match what [NIST](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html#71-session-bindings) says.

I would recommend changing to:

> Verify that session tokens are generated using a secure random function.

The CWE should also be changed from [CWE-331: Insufficient Entropy](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/331.html) to [CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/330.html).

Any objections?

@set-reminder 2 weeks @tghosth open PR if no opposition.

Current wording of [3.2.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md#v32-session-binding):

> Verify that session tokens are generated using approved cryptographic algorithms.

This doesn't really make sense in the context nor does it really match what [NIST](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html#71-session-bindings) says.

I would recommend changing to:

> [MODIFIED] Verify that opaque session tokens are generated using a secure random function.

The CWE should also be changed from [CWE-331: Insufficient Entropy](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/331.html) to [CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/330.html).

Any objections?

The use of "opaque" session tokens should distinguish between this and something like a JWT.

 [3.2.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md#v32-session-binding) should also be clarified to mention opaque.

Suggested:
> [MODIFIED] Verify that **opaque** session tokens possess at least 128 bits of entropy.





@set-reminder 2 weeks @tghosth open PR if no opposition.
